---

## How to Get the URLs for `trello.com`

### 1. Build the Request URL

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls
```

### 2. Add Query Parameters

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `limit`   | Number of results to return (max 20 in your case) | `limit=20` |
| `cursor`  | Pagination cursor to start from | `cursor=tr_cursor1` |

Full URL:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls?limit=20&cursor=tr_cursor1
```

### 3. Set the HTTP Headers

```http
x-apikey: tr_key001
Accept: application/json
```

### 4. Make the Request

You can use `curl`, Postman, or any HTTP client library:

```bash
curl -X GET \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls?limit=20&cursor=tr_cursor1" \
     -H "x-apikey: tr_key001" \
     -H "Accept: application/json"
```

### 5. Parse the Response

The JSON response will look something like this:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "https://trello.com/board/abc123",
      "attributes": {
        "url": "https://trello.com/board/abc123",
        "last_analysis_stats": { ... },
        "last_analysis_date": "2024-05-12T10:15:00Z",
        ...
      }
    },
    ...
  ],
  "links": {
    "next": "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/urls?cursor=tr_cursor2"
  }
}
```

- The `data` array contains up to 20 URL objects.
- The `links.next` field gives you the cursor for the next page (`tr_cursor2` in this example).

### 6. Handling Pagination

If you need more than 20 URLs, repeat the request using the cursor from the `links.next` field until you’ve collected all URLs or reached your desired limit.

---

## Quick Checklist

- [ ] Replace `tr_key001` with your actual API key if it’s different.
- [ ] Ensure you’re using HTTPS.
- [ ] Respect VirusTotal’s rate limits (typically 4 requests/min for free tier, 60/min for paid).

If you run into any errors (e.g., 401 Unauthorized, 429 Too Many Requests), double‑check your API key and the number of requests per minute.
